title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Playoff
items.text: Joaquin Niemann defeated Talor Gooch with a birdie on the first playoff hole at LIV Golf Korea after both finished 12-under 268, earning his first LIV title of 2026 and eighth overall.

items.headline: Stout Leads NCAA Championship
items.text: Oklahoma State junior Preston Stout leads the 2026 NCAA Championship at 11-under after a third-round 65, putting him on the cusp of possibly securing an invitation to next year’s Masters.
